mapper.sql: SELECT bank_doc, cmpy, bank_flow_no, my_acc_no, pay_acc_no, pay_acc_name, curr, amt, tran_date, tran_time, summary, cust, amt_process, amt_receipt FROM z000_sd_pay_flow_cash
mapper.select:
SELECT a.bank_doc, a.cmpy, a.bank_flow_no, a.my_acc_no, a.pay_acc_no, a.pay_acc_name, a.curr, a.amt, a.tran_date, a.tran_time, a.summary, a.cust, a.amt_process, a.amt_receipt, a.amt - a.amt_process - a.amt_receipt AS amtRemain FROM z000_sd_pay_flow_cash a
AND @S@ a.bank_doc = bankDoc @E@ AND @S@ a.cmpy = cmpy @E@ AND @S@ a.bank_flow_no = bankFlowNo @E@ AND @S@ a.my_acc_no = myAccNo @E@ AND @S@ a.pay_acc_no = payAccNo @E@ AND @S@ a.pay_acc_name = payAccName @E@ AND @S@ a.amt = amt @E@ AND @S@ a.tran_date = tranDate @E@ AND @S@ a.tran_time = tranTime @E@ AND @S@ a.cust = cust @E@
ORDER BY a.bank_doc DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO z000_sd_pay_flow_cash (bank_doc, cmpy, bank_flow_no, my_acc_no, pay_acc_no, pay_acc_name, curr, amt, tran_date, tran_time, summary, cust, amt_process, amt_receipt) VALUES (#{bankDoc}, #{cmpy}, #{bankFlowNo}, #{myAccNo}, #{payAccNo}, #{payAccName}, #{curr}, #{amt}, #{tranDate}, #{tranTime}, #{summary}, #{cust}, 0, 0)

INSERT INTO z000_sd_pay_flow_cash (bank_doc, cmpy, bank_flow_no, my_acc_no, pay_acc_no, pay_acc_name, curr, amt, tran_date, tran_time, summary, cust, amt_process, amt_receipt) VALUES
